profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.description:
- Assisted in developing Kubernetes based cloud offering by working on user cluster master deployments using Go and Ansible.
- Took ownership of application that transmits cluster health to user and worked on improving performance and functionality. 
- Helped migrate applications such as machine provisioning tools and slack bots to our cloud service

positions.title: Undergraduate Technical Intern - APD
positions.description:
- Added functionality and automation to an open source chip design layout viewer tool in C++
- Utilized Python to make chip design (GDS) file information easily viewable and searchable.
- Improved view for automatically generated customer datasheets using HTML/CSS and developed a tool to help engineers search for them using JavaScript and Python

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Added functionality to a Drilling Simulator utilized by Quality Assurance personnel utilizing Java and MySQL. Features included replaying real drilling data and organizing data by drilling attribute in a MySQL database
- Introduced to Agile Methodologies and attended weekly meetings to present progress and discuss further development
